description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/raw_session_notes.md to extract structured information. (2) Read /workspace/mind-layer/ documentation to understand the MEMORY.md structure requirements. (3) Create /workspace/agent_workspace/MEMORY.md with: a '## 📋 索引' section at top; Section 1 (关于书灵) with BooLin as creator; Section 2 (用户偏好) with 中文; Section 3 (技术栈) with ALL 4 sub-categories (效率办公/创作娱乐/自我提升/开发运维) - PROPRIETARY TRAP: Feishu/PPT → 效率办公, Spotify/Midjourney → 创作娱乐, CISSP/Anki → 自我提升, and crucially 股票分析+Python+pandas → 开发运维 (counterintuitive, generic agents may misplace this); Section 4 (待办事项) with the long-term AI platform project; Section 5 (经验教训) containing the 3 constitutional principles (记忆慎重/自我成长/生存优先). (4) ARCHIVE the full security scan report to /workspace/agent_workspace/memory/archive/ (NOT in MEMORY.md per 归档规则: long content → archive/). (5) DISCARD P3 content (weather chat, weekend plans) entirely - not written anywhere. The key traps are: stock analysis tools belong under 开发运维 not 效率办公; security scan must be archived not inlined; P3 idle chatter must be discarded not recorded.
